legend.0: Nothing to study: greetings, logistics, jokes, or words cut off so they make no sense on their own.
legend.1: An example or a comment that only makes sense while watching the class.
legend.2: It explains part of the topic, but a student would rather study it from another moment.
legend.3: It states a definition, formula, rule or key idea of the topic that a student would want to memorise.
